STEP 1 - Vessel type: flat square plate (white, rim band visible, flat centre, no inner wall).

STEP 2 - Vessel size:
a) Square plates are typically 20-30 cm. The plate here looks medium-large, roughly a standard dinner plate size.
b) Reference: the salmon chunks are about 3-4 cm each. The plate spans roughly 8-9 salmon-chunk lengths across, which gives about 27-30 cm. Type cue suggests ~26 cm side; reference suggests ~28 cm.
Final width = 27 cm (square), area = 27² = 729 cm².

STEP 3 - Food items:
- Salmon with rice (pink-orange fish pieces with rice/herbs): covers roughly the lower-left quadrant, about 35% of the plate area, so ~255 cm². Pieces are about 2-3 cm thick, stacked up to about 2 deep at the peak, average ~2 cm. Volume ≈ 255 × 2 = 510 ml. Mixed fish and rice with bulk density ~1.0 g/ml, but about half is rice (0.8) and half fish (1.0): ~0.9 g/ml. Fish-and-rice mix ≈ 460 g. Split: salmon ~260 g, rice in mix ~200 g.
- Brown grains (wheat berries/farro with dried fruit, upper-left mound): covers about 25% of the plate, ~180 cm². Mound about 1.5 cm average thickness (peak ~3 cm). Volume ≈ 270 ml × 0.8 = ~215 g.
- Vegetable salad (diced cucumber, yellow squash, red pepper, zucchini, on right): covers about 20%, ~145 cm², average thickness ~1.2 cm, volume ~175 ml × 0.6 = ~105 g.
- Greens garnish (small amount, cooked leafy): ~10 g.

STEP 4 - Hidden food: rice base under the salmon is already counted in the mix. No further hidden layer assumed.

STEP 5 - kcal per 100 g (as served):
- Salmon (cooked): ~200 kcal/100 g
- Rice (cooked, in the mix): ~130 kcal/100 g
- Cooked wheat berries/grain with dried fruit: ~150 kcal/100 g
- Mixed diced vegetables (cucumber, squash, pepper) : ~35 kcal/100 g
- Cooked leafy greens: ~25 kcal/100 g

Totals:
- Salmon: 260 g × 2.00 = 520 kcal
- Rice in mix: 200 g × 1.30 = 260 kcal
- Grain: 215 g × 1.50 = 323 kcal
- Vegetables: 105 g × 0.35 = 37 kcal
- Greens: 10 g × 0.25 = 3 kcal

Total ≈ 1,143 kcal, about 785 g.
